question.prompt: The data 1, 2, 3, 4 are arranged in ascending order, and \(n=4\). Find the 50th percentile. Rule: \(i=n\times 50\%\); when \(i\) is an integer, take the mean of the values at positions \(i\) and \(i+1\).

solutions.explanation: \(i=2\). Take the 2nd and 3rd values, which are 2 and 3. Their mean is \(5/2\).
solutions.title: Apply the integer-index percentile rule
